headings.text: Why this product works so well

blocks.text: This Heavy Duty Drying Towel uses an ultra-dense 1200GSM dual-sided microfibre blend designed to pull water off the paint with almost no effort. Each pass removes a huge amount of water, making it ideal for larger vehicles, heavy rinse-downs, or anyone who wants the quickest, easiest drying experience possible.

The 90 × 60 cm size offers excellent control while still covering large areas, meaning fewer passes, faster drying, and less contact with the paint — helping to prevent streaks, smears, and unwanted marks.

Its double-sided plush construction holds a serious amount of water while staying soft, gentle, and manageable. Whether you prefer to lay it flat, pat dry, or glide it across the surface, this towel makes light work of even the wettest panels.

matches.question: What’s the difference between this and the XL 800GSM Drying Towel?
matches.answer: The Heavy Duty towel is thicker at 1200GSM and double-sided, so it holds more water and feels more substantial in the hand. The XL 800GSM towel is larger in size but lighter in feel, so it glides a bit easier. It mainly comes down to whether you prefer a lighter, larger towel or a smaller, heavier one.

metadata.title: Heavy Duty Drying Towel | Premium Car Care Tools UK | Street Kingz1
metadata.description: Ultra-absorbent 1200GSM drying towel designed for everyday UK drivers. Built for real-world use with fast UK delivery from Street Kingz.

specifications.text: • GSM: 1200GSM (dual-sided plush microfibre) • Size: 90 × 60 cm • Material: Premium dual-sided microfibre • Edge: Soft microfibre edging • Suitable for: Cars, SUVs, vans, paintwork, glass and exterior plastics • Best use: Post-wash drying, especially on larger or heavily rinsed vehicles • Wash: Machine washable on a cold, gentle cycle with microfibre or non-bio detergent • Care: Do not use fabric softener or bleach • Dry: Air dry only, do not tumble dry

care_usage.text: 1) Gently wash the vehicle using a pH-safe shampoo such as the Origin Shampoo . 2) Rinse thoroughly and remove standing water with a light sheet of water. 3) Lay the towel flat on the panel. 4) Gently drag or pat dry, no pressure needed. 5) Wring out only when completely saturated. 6) After use, wash on a gentle cycle with microfibre detergent or non-bio detergent.

additional_faqs.question: Is it too heavy when it’s wet?
additional_faqs.answer: It will feel heavier than a lighter towel once it’s fully loaded with water, but that’s the trade-off for the extra absorbency. The 90 × 60 cm size keeps it manageable so it doesn’t feel like you’re wrestling it.

additional_faqs.question: Can I use it on ceramic-coated or waxed cars?
additional_faqs.answer: Yes. It’s safe on coated, waxed and sealed paint. It won’t strip protection and works well with modern coatings.

additional_faqs.question: How many towels do I need to dry a whole car?
additional_faqs.answer: One Heavy Duty towel is enough for most cars and SUVs. For larger vans or if you like to swap towels halfway through, two makes the job even easier.

additional_faqs.question: How should I wash and store it?
additional_faqs.answer: Wash it on a cold, gentle cycle with microfibre-safe or non-bio detergent. Skip the fabric softener and air dry it flat or on a line. Store it dry, folded, and away from dirt and dust, ideally in the storage bag it came in.
